description: Search the AppView's reader directory. An actor is listed once the AppView has mirrored at least one record authored by it; handles, display names and avatars come from the AppView's own `actors` read model, not from a live PDS read. This operation does not write user records.

main.description: Search the AppView's reader directory. An actor is listed once the AppView has mirrored at least one record authored by it; handles, display names and avatars come from the AppView's own `actors` read model, not from a live PDS read. This operation does not write user records.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the actor's handle or display name, or an exact DID. Pagination is applied after this filter, so a page is never short because matches were trimmed.

hasRecords.description: Restrict to actors owning at least one mirrored record in ANY of these collections (OR semantics). The predicate runs in the same WHERE as `q`, before ordering and pagination. `net.olamaelcu.livtet.actor.profile` is not mirrored by the AppView today, so naming it matches nobody; see the ingestion note in `docs/architecture.md`.

offset.description: Number of matching actors to skip. Actors are ordered by `coalesce(handle, did), did`, so pages are stable while that key holds.

limit.description: Maximum number of actors to return in this page.

hasMore.description: True when another page exists. Read from `LIMIT limit+1`, so it is correct at the boundary without a second count.

total.description: Matching actors across all pages. Returned on the first page only, from a count issued beside the page query.

errors.name: InvalidQuery
errors.description: `q` was supplied but is shorter than 3 or longer than 200 characters after trimming, or `hasRecords` names more than 8 collections.
